title: Haplotype-Based Trait Analysis for Plant Breeding
text: Try now barley example data ships package: console guides every step ends colour-coded summary:   Tell HaploTraitR columns use:  Call run_haplotraitr() per trait, GWAS file output folder:
code: library(HaploTraitR)  results <- run_haplotraitr(   gwas      = "my_gwas_results.csv",   # marker, chromosome, position, p-value   genotypes = "my_genotypes.hmp.txt",  # HapMap (.hmp.txt) or VCF (.vcf / .vcf.gz)   pheno     = "my_phenotypes.tsv",     # first column = accession, then one column per trait   trait     = "Yield",   unit      = "t/ha",   outfolder = "results_yield",   higher_is_better = TRUE              # FALSE for e.g. disease scores or days to heading ) ex <- function(f) system.file("extdata", f, package = "HaploTraitR")  results <- run_haplotraitr(   gwas = ex("gwas_area_ann19.csv.gz"), genotypes = ex("Barley_50K.tsv.gz"),   pheno = ex("area_ann19.tsv"), trait = "Area", unit = "cm2",   outfolder = "barley_example", config = list(fdr_threshold = 0.1) ) run_haplotraitr(..., config = list(rsid_col = "Marker", chr_col = "Chr",                                    pos_col = "Pos", pval_col = "P.value")) for (trait in c("Yield", "Height", "Heading")) {   run_haplotraitr(gwas = paste0("gwas_", trait, ".csv"), genotypes = "panel.hmp.txt",                   pheno = "traits.tsv", trait = trait, outfolder = paste0("results_", trait),                   higher_is_better = trait != "Heading") }

title: Haplotype-Based Trait Analysis for Plant Breeding
text: Change settings set_config() config argument run_haplotraitr().  Every step run_haplotraitr() available :  LD squared correlation (r²) allele dosages, standard unphased r². Blocks: SNPs within dist_threshold GWAS SNP linked r² ≥ ld_threshold. connected group contains GWAS SNP block. GWAS SNPs share block analysed . Haplotypes allele combinations comb_freq_threshold. accession missing calls (hap_max_missing) assigned single haplotype matches observed alleles. Tests: Welch ANOVA (Kruskal–Wallis) per block, pairwise Welch t-tests (Wilcoxon tests) p_adjust_method correction. Letter groups use insert--absorb algorithm. workflow diagram drawn JavaScript tools/flowchart/flowchart.html. Regenerate PNG tools/flowchart/render.sh.
code: library(HaploTraitR) set_config(list(phenotypename = "Area", phenotypeunit = "cm2", fdr_threshold = 0.1,                 outfolder = create_unique_result_folder(location = "sampleout"))) ex <- function(f) system.file("extdata", f, package = "HaploTraitR")  gwas      <- read_gwas_file(ex("gwas_area_ann19.csv.gz")) hapmap    <- readHapmap(ex("Barley_50K.tsv.gz"))            # or readVCF("file.vcf.gz") pheno     <- read.delim(ex("area_ann19.tsv"))  gwas_sig  <- filter_gwas_data(gwas)                          # significant GWAS SNPs windows   <- getDistClusters(gwas_sig, hapmap)               # SNPs near each GWAS SNP LDsInfo   <- computeLDclusters(hapmap, windows)              # LD (r2) matrices blocks    <- getLDclusters(LDsInfo)                          # LD blocks haps      <- convertLDclusters2Haps(hapmap, blocks)          # haplotypes per block haps      <- getHapCombSamples(haps, hapmap)                 # accessions per haplotype acc       <- getSNPcombTables(haps, pheno)                   # accession x haplotype x trait tests     <- testSNPcombs(acc)                               # pairwise haplotype tests summary   <- summarize_haplotypes(haps, acc, tests)          # effects, superior haplotypes markers   <- diagnostic_markers(haps, summary)               # markers for MAS ranking   <- rank_accessions(haps, pheno, summary)           # candidate parents  plot_haplotype_block("2H:582673984", haps, summary)          # one block (by block id or GWAS SNP) plotHapCombBoxPlot("2H:582673984", acc, tests)               # trait by haplotype plot_effect_summary(summary) plot_candidate_accessions(ranking, summary) plot_haplotypes_genome(gwas, haps, summary = summary)

code: list_config() #>  #> ── HaploTraitR settings ── #>  #>   outfolder            NULL       Output folder for all results #>   dist_threshold       1,000,000  Window (bp) around each GWAS SNP in which SNPs are collected #>   dist_cluster_count   5          Minimum number of SNPs in a window / LD block #>   ld_threshold         0.3        Minimum LD (r2) to link two SNPs into the same block #>   comb_freq_threshold  0.1        Minimum frequency of a haplotype (rarer ones are pooled as 'Other') #>   hap_max_missing      0.2        Maximum fraction of missing calls allowed when assigning an accession to a haplotype #>   fdr_threshold        0.05       FDR threshold used to select significant GWAS SNPs #>   fdr_method           fdr        Method used by p.adjust() to compute GWAS FDR #>   t_test_threshold     0.05       Significance level (alpha) for haplotype tests #>   t_test_method        t.test     Test used to compare haplotypes: 't.test' (Welch) or 'wilcox.test' #>   p_adjust_method      holm       Multiple-testing correction for pairwise haplotype tests #>   higher_is_better     TRUE       TRUE if a higher trait value is desirable (e.g. yield), FALSE otherwise (e.g. disease score) #>   rsid_col             rsid       Marker name column in the GWAS file #>   pos_col              pos        Position column in the GWAS file #>   chr_col              chr        Chromosome column in the GWAS file #>   pval_col             p          P-value column in the GWAS file #>   fdr_col              fdr        FDR column in the GWAS file (computed if absent) #>   phenotypename        Phenotype  Trait name used in titles and file names #>   pheno_col            Phenotype  Trait column in the phenotype file #>   phenotypeunit        NULL       Trait unit shown on plot axes #>   plot_format          png        Plot file format: 'png' or 'pdf' #>   plot_dpi             300        Resolution of PNG plots #> Changed values are yellow. text: Output folder layout: * `HaploTraitR_<trait>.xlsx` - Excel report (start ) * `plots/genome_overview` - GWAS Manhattan plot haplotype blocks * `plots/haplotype_effects_summary` - effect every haplotype every block * `plots/candidate_accessions` - accessions carrying superior haplotypes * `plots/haplotype_blocks/` - alleles, trait effects LD block * `plots/haplotype_trait_plots/` - trait distribution per haplotype * `plots/gwas_snp_plots/` - trait distribution per genotype GWAS SNP * `tables/` - CSV copies tables; `LD_matrices/` - LD (r2) matrices
